verses.restored: Bow down thine ear, O YHWH, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

familiar.text: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

modern.text: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

original.text: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה יְהוָ֣ה אָזְנְךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָֽנִי

verses.restored: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

familiar.text: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

modern.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.

original.text: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי חָסִ֪יד אָ֥נִי הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Be merciful to me, O Lord: for I cry to thee daily.

familiar.text: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

modern.text: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.

original.text: חָנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כָּל הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for to thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

familiar.text: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

modern.text: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

original.text: שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא

verses.restored: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy to all them that call upon thee.

familiar.text: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

modern.text: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.

original.text: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Give ear, O YHWH, to my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

familiar.text: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

modern.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.

original.text: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה יְ֭הוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי

verses.restored: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

familiar.text: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

modern.text: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.

verses.restored: Among the gods there is none like to thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like to thy works.

familiar.text: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

modern.text: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.

original.text: אֵין כָּמ֖וֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֵ֣ין כְּֽמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ

verses.restored: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

familiar.text: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

modern.text: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

original.text: כָּל גּוֹיִ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִֽיכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

familiar.text: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

modern.text: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.

original.text: כִּֽי גָד֣וֹל אַ֭תָּה וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Teach me thy way, O YHWH; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

familiar.text: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

modern.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.

original.text: ה֘וֹרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

familiar.text: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

modern.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.

original.text: אוֹדְךָ֤ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכָל לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

familiar.text: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

modern.text: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

original.text: כִּֽי חַ֭סְדְּךָ גָּד֣וֹל עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּחְתִּיָּֽה

verses.restored: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

familiar.text: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

modern.text: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, with no regard for You.

original.text: אֱלֹהִ֤ים זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָֽמוּ עָלַ֗י וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם

verses.restored: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

familiar.text: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

modern.text: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי אֵל רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת

verses.restored: O turn to me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength to thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

familiar.text: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

modern.text: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.

original.text: פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחָ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן אֲמָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Show me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, YHWH, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

familiar.text: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

modern.text: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

original.text: עֲשֵֽׂה עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי
